image_placeholders.description: Abstract visualization of a global technology wave or digital transformation, dark tones with purple/blue highlights
image_placeholders.purpose: Creates urgency and establishes the 'world is changing' theme

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Background image with centered title text. Title: 'The World Has Moved' (世界は動いた). Subtitle: 'Privacy-Preserving Tech is Now Standard'. Single provocative question at bottom: 'Will You Lead or Follow?'
visual_designs.justification: Opening slide must create immediate emotional impact. A full-bleed image with minimal text establishes urgency without overwhelming. The single question forces engagement.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Massive centered number '$7.5B' in primary white with green accent. Small subtitle below: 'ZKP Market by 2033'. Even smaller context line: 'from $1.3B in 2024 (CAGR 18.6%)'
visual_designs.justification: The $7.5B market size is the single most compelling data point. Jobs-style big number creates immediate impact. The growth trajectory speaks for itself without needing a chart.

visual_designs.diagram_code:
```mermaid graph LR subgraph TODAY["Today's Reality"] G["Google Wallet
ZKP Age Verify"] A["Apple Photos
FHE Search"] end G --> U["Billions of
Users"] A --> U style G fill:#22c55e,color:#fff style A fill:#22c55e,color:#fff style U fill:#8b5cf6,color:#fff ```
visual_designs.content_arrangement: Title at top: 'Not Future Tech. Today's Products.' Mermaid diagram centered showing Google and Apple converging to 'Billions of Users'. Logos can be placed near respective nodes.
visual_designs.justification: A simple convergence diagram shows that two tech giants have independently chosen the same path, making the trend undeniable. 4 nodes keeps it clean.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Large '2026' in red (#ef4444) as the focal point. Above it: EU flag icon. Below it: 'eIDAS 2.0 Takes Effect'. Subtext: 'Privacy-Preserving ID Becomes Mandatory'
visual_designs.justification: The year 2026 is the critical deadline that creates urgency. Red color signals warning/urgency. The EU flag provides instant context without words.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Massive '110,000' in red (#ef4444) centered. Small text below: 'Cybersecurity Talent Gap in Japan'. Even smaller: '79M IT workers short by 2030'
visual_designs.justification: The 11万人 (110,000) shortage is a shocking number that tells the story instantly. Red emphasizes this as a crisis. No diagram needed - the number is the message.

visual_designs.diagram_code:
```mermaid graph TD H["Hire ZK/FHE
Engineers?"] -->|"Japan Market"| X["❌ Not Found"] H -->|"Solution"| T["Train Your Own"] style H fill:#8b5cf6,color:#fff style X fill:#ef4444,color:#fff style T fill:#22c55e,color:#fff ```
visual_designs.content_arrangement: Title: 'You Cannot Hire What Doesn't Exist'. Simple 3-node diagram showing the choice: hiring fails, training succeeds. The visual makes the logical conclusion obvious.
visual_designs.justification: This binary choice diagram makes the logical conclusion inescapable: if you can't hire, you must train. 3 nodes is minimal and clear. Colors reinforce the message (red=failure, green=solution).

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Left column: 'ZK Core Program 2026' as title with ZK Tokyo + UTokyo logos stacked. Right column: Three key points with v-clicks: '6 Weeks Hybrid Format', 'Work-Compatible Schedule', 'World-Class Curriculum'
visual_designs.justification: This is the solution introduction slide. Two-cols allows logos to establish credibility while 3 key differentiators explain the format. v-clicks control pacing.

image_placeholders.description: Photo of Vitalik Buterin at ZK Core Program 2025 Demo Day (if available), or a professional conference/presentation setting
image_placeholders.purpose: Visual proof of world-class credibility and international attention

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Background image of Vitalik/demo day event. Overlay text: 'Vitalik Buterin Attended'. Subtitle: '2025 Final Demo Day'. This is a credibility slide - the image does the talking.
visual_designs.justification: A photo of Vitalik at the event is worth a thousand words of credibility claims. This is the ultimate 'show don't tell' moment. Minimal text lets the image convey trust.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Title: 'Proven Results'. Three achievement cards with v-clicks, each with icon/logo: '5+ Teams Won ETHTokyo 2025', 'EF Grant Recipients', 'International Research Publications'. Each card has green accent border.
visual_designs.justification: These are concrete achievements that prove program value. Three distinct achievement cards with recognizable logos create credibility through evidence. v-clicks allow presenter to elaborate on each.

visual_designs.diagram_code:
```mermaid graph LR S["Your
Challenge"] --> P["Program
Participants"] P --> D["Demo Day
Solutions"] D --> H["Direct
Hiring Path"] style S fill:#f59e0b,color:#fff style P fill:#8b5cf6,color:#fff style D fill:#8b5cf6,color:#fff style H fill:#22c55e,color:#fff ```
visual_designs.content_arrangement: Title: 'Theme Proposal Rights'. Horizontal flow diagram showing: Your Challenge → Participants Work On It → Solutions Presented → Hiring Pipeline. This visualizes the unique sponsor benefit.
visual_designs.justification: The theme proposal right is the key differentiator. A simple 4-node flow shows how sponsor challenges become hiring opportunities. Colors show the value flow (orange=your investment, purple=program magic, green=your gain).

visual_designs.diagram_code:
```mermaid graph TD I["One
Investment"] --> T["Talent
Pipeline"] I --> R["R&D
Insights"] I --> B["Tech
Branding"] style I fill:#f59e0b,color:#fff style T fill:#22c55e,color:#fff style R fill:#22c55e,color:#fff style B fill:#22c55e,color:#fff ```
visual_designs.content_arrangement: Title: 'Triple ROI from Single Investment'. Diagram shows one investment branching to three green outcomes. Each outcome node is self-explanatory. No additional text needed.
visual_designs.justification: The '3 benefits from 1 investment' message is perfectly suited for a branching diagram. 4 nodes total, one-to-many relationship is immediately clear. Green outcomes reinforce positive value.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Title: 'Start from ¥500K'. Three tier cards stacked vertically with v-clicks: Bronze (¥500K): '1 Theme, Logo, Demo Access' / Silver (¥1M): '3 Themes, Speaking Slot, Mixer' / Gold (¥2M): '5 Themes, Premium Exposure, Dedicated Session'. Use accent colors for tier names.
visual_designs.justification: Pricing needs to be clear and scannable. Three tiers as distinct cards let sponsors quickly identify their fit. v-clicks allow presenter to walk through each tier. Keeping descriptions minimal avoids text overload.

image_placeholders.description: QR code linking to sponsorship inquiry form or contact page
image_placeholders.purpose: Immediate action pathway for interested sponsors

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Dark background with centered QR code (white). Above QR: 'Become a ZK Core Sponsor'. Below QR: Contact email and/or URL. Single CTA statement: 'Shape the Future of Privacy Tech in Japan.'
visual_designs.justification: Final slide must make action easy. QR code enables immediate follow-up. Minimal text focuses attention on the single CTA. Clean closing leaves professional impression.

bullet_points_minimized.justification: Out of 13 slides, 0 use plain bullet points. All slides use either: single numbers (slides 2, 4, 5), Mermaid diagrams (slides 3, 6, 10, 11), full-bleed images (slides 1, 8, 13), or styled key points with v-clicks (slides 7, 9, 12). No default bullet point lists anywhere.

one_chart_one_message_applied.justification: Each Mermaid diagram conveys exactly one message: Slide 3 = 'Tech giants have converged on this tech', Slide 6 = 'Hiring fails, training works', Slide 10 = 'Your challenge becomes your hiring pipeline', Slide 11 = 'One investment, three returns'. All messages can be stated in one sentence.

mermaid_node_limit_respected.justification: All diagrams have 4 or fewer nodes. Slide 3: 4 nodes (Google, Apple, subgraph, Users), Slide 6: 3 nodes, Slide 10: 4 nodes, Slide 11: 4 nodes. No diagram exceeds the 5-node limit.

image_placeholders_added.justification: Added image placeholders for: cover slide (1), Google/Apple logos (2), EU flag (1), ZK Tokyo + UTokyo logos (2), Vitalik photo (1), ETHTokyo + EF logos (2), QR code (1). All anecdote/credibility/CTA slides have appropriate visual placeholders.

color_consistency_maintained.justification: All slides use the defined color palette: #0f0f0f (background), #ffffff (primary text), #22c55e (positive/solution - used in success states), #ef4444 (negative/problem - used in shortage numbers and deadline), #8b5cf6 (brand/program elements), #f59e0b (accent/investment). No off-palette colors specified.
